title: Retire ArrayMesh: measure HalfEdgeMesh on the largest models, then build HalfEdgeMesh everywhere and compile straight to the render buffer
description:
Repo plan merge 3C.15, user's request: 'check if array mesh really needs to exist anymore mostly use halfedge everywhere and seems to be fast enough'. ArrayMesh is referenced by 63 main and 28 test files; every loader (glTF, OBJ, OFF, PLY) builds one, as do about 12 nodes (CubeMesh, Subdivision, Extrude, InsetFaces, Transform, CoonsPatch, CheckerMaterial, GridMapQuads, QuadExtract), GridToMesh2D/3D, DebugCapsuleRuntime, MeshRepair, MeshMergeByDistance and SemanticPatchDecomposer.toArrayMesh (which HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.java:257 calls to upload a mesh). ArrayMeshEngine duplicates HalfEdgeMeshEngine/ops (delete, merge-by-distance, join, subdivide, solidify) and callers branch on instanceof in about 52 places. Step 1: measure HalfEdgeMesh construction time and memory, and render upload, on the largest models (crawfish GLB, fertility, Buddha) against ArrayMesh; record on the ticket. Step 2, if acceptable: producers build HalfEdgeMesh, the renderer compiles straight to HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData, and ArrayMesh, ArrayMeshEngine, QuadMeshTopologyHelper and the instanceof branches are deleted. If the numbers say a dense path must stay for a specific case, stop and report before step 2.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.

User decisions 2026-10-18, after step 1: (a) ArrayMesh stays, under its name, only as the indexed form of meshes HalfEdgeMesh cannot hold (raw non-manifold/degenerate scans, unoriented MeshRepair output); only the loaders and MeshRepair produce it; everything else builds HalfEdgeMesh and ArrayMeshEngine, the converters and the instanceof branches go. The 2.2-2.4x memory of HalfEdgeMesh is accepted. Also move HalfEdgeMeshEngine.compileSurfaceData (the one rendering method in the geometry engine) into the render side, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime, as part of compiling straight to the render buffer.
definition-of-done:
1. Measurements (load, build, upload, memory) for the three models recorded on the ticket before any deletion.
2. If retired: no ArrayMesh, ArrayMeshEngine or QuadMeshTopologyHelper; no instanceof ArrayMesh/HalfEdgeMesh branches; load and first-frame times within the measured budget.
3. Every DSL output and loaded model fingerprint identical to master (MeshCanonicalFingerprint), quad-suite fingerprints unchanged.
4. Unit suite passes; launch entry and screenshots of the crawfish and a subdivided primitive.

7. HalfEdgeMeshEngine.compileSurfaceData lives in the render runtime (HalfEdgeMeshRuntime); the geometry engine has no rendering code.
8. The HalfEdgeBuildBenchmark representationsOnLargestModels report lines ([representation] ...) are the benchmark's output and stay.
testing-plan:
1. A timing harness over the three models (tmp/, not committed unless asked).
2. Fingerprints before and after.
3. mvn test.
changes-made: Step 1 measurements (MESH-60 agent, before any code change; worktree mesh-60 on eng-33). Harness: tracked benchmark HalfEdgeBuildBenchmark#representationsOnLargestModels (new test method, benchmark/ dir, run with -Dtest=), 2 warm-up + 7 timed rounds per model, ArrayMesh and HalfEdgeMesh alternating which goes first each round, medians; log tmp/mesh60-bench-1.log. Per sample: load = parser to ArrayMesh; build = ArrayMesh edge topology (QuadMeshTopologyHelper) vs toHalfEdgeMesh (packedBuild + normals); retained = heap delta after GC holding the mesh; compile = compileSurfaceData (the render buffer); edgeLines = the wireframe LineSet over every edge (rest of upload); texturedSplit = CornerUvSplit for the textured draw. FERTILITY V=13971 F=27954: Array load 22.2 build 2.9 ms 2.9 MiB compile 0.2 edges 1.0 | HalfEdge load 22.3 build 2.6 ms 6.9 MiB compile 0.4 edges 0.9. BUDDHA V=99370 F=198736: Array load 100.8 build 21.5 ms 35.1 MiB compile 1.4 edges 8.1 | HalfEdge load 100.9 build 21.9 ms 79.5 MiB compile 2.3 edges 5.6. CRAWFISH IMG_4109 raw GLB V=468350 F=936035: Array load 36.1 (warm, parse after the first) build 117.3 ms 108.0 MiB compile 7.4 edges 49.4 split 23.9 | HalfEdgeMesh REFUSED: 'Degenerate edge on vertex 53309' (the raw scan is non-manifold; the quad suite's crawfish load fails on the same exception). CRAWFISH repaired (repair_mesh median 617 ms; V=469131 F=938302 rebuilt from its arrays): Array build 90.8 ms 108.0 MiB compile 7.5 edges 31.1 | HalfEdge build 83.0 ms 261.3 MiB compile 12.2 edges 25.1. Verdict: construction time equal within noise on all three, compile +1-5 ms, edge lines faster on HalfEdge; memory 2.2-2.4x (crawfish +153 MiB). First frame (run-scene sceneReady wait, mesh-viewer, 3 rotated rounds, tmp/mesh60-firstframe-base.txt): crawfish 2.0 s, buddha 1.0-2.0 s, fertility 1.0 s (route resolution is 1 s). A dense path must stay for meshes with no half-edge form: raw scans (non-manifold/degenerate) and repair_mesh output with unoriented edges (MeshRepair already returns an ArrayMesh there).

Step 1 baselines (before any code change): quad suite 14/14 MATCH against mesh-59-step2 (signatures and screenshots; /home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/mesh-60-before). DSL fixtures sweep (tmp/mesh60-fixtures-base.txt, 40 DSLs, 0 timeouts) byte-identical to MESH-59 step 2. Ring fingerprints/regions on crawfish and fertility, dungeon_2d/3d fingerprints and the timing/node-inspect JSON shapes (tmp/mesh60-regress-base.txt) identical to MESH-59 step 2 apart from log paths and ports. Scripts: tmp/mesh60-fixtures.sh, tmp/mesh60-regress.sh, tmp/mesh60-dungeon-fingerprint.sh, tmp/mesh60-firstframe.sh. Stopped at the phase gate; step 2 waits for the user.

Step 2 implemented (uncommitted, worktree mesh-60), per user decision (a). ArrayMesh keeps its name and is only the indexed form of meshes HalfEdgeMesh cannot hold; only MeshLoader.indexedMesh (all four parsers: HalfEdgeMesh bulk build in file order with the file's normals, else ArrayMesh) and MeshRepair (unoriented output, and its weld stage) build one; QuadMeshTopologyHelper is folded into ArrayMesh's private Topology. Deleted: ArrayMeshEngine, QuadMeshTopologyHelper, ArrayMesh.toHalfEdgeMesh/withPositions/fromQuads/copy*/compileSurfaceData and its op statics, HalfEdgeMeshEngine.fromMeshTopology and compileSurfaceData, HalfEdgeMesh.compileSurfaceData, SemanticPatchDecomposer.toArrayMesh, GeometryBundle.mutableMesh, MeshMergeByDistance.mergeToArrayMesh, the viewer's on-demand half-edge copy, AutomationRuntime.normalizeMeshPositions and BatchDslEvaluator.normalizeArrayMesh (replaced by MeshDistance.normalizedPositions). No instanceof ArrayMesh/HalfEdgeMesh or casts remain in main: MeshTopology.asHalfEdgeMesh(consumer) (HalfEdgeMesh returns itself; ArrayMesh throws '<node> needs a manifold mesh ... run repair_mesh on it first'), plus default packedPositions()/packedFaceVertices(); HalfEdgeMeshEngine gains compact, denseTriangles and a bulk subdivideQuadsOnce(MeshTopology). Every producer and node builds HalfEdgeMesh in the old vertex/face order: CubeMesh, CoonsPatch, CheckerMaterial, Extrude (face normals computed the old unit way so positions are unchanged), Inset, LoopCut (loopCutAxis inlined), Solidify (SolidifyMeshNode.solidifyQuads, also used by BiRailLoft), Subdivide, Subdivision (edges from a bulk build, numbered in first-appearance order exactly as the old helper), Transform, GridMapQuads/QuadExtract (ExtractedQuadMesh.toMesh), GridToMesh2D/3D, DebugCapsuleRuntime, MeshAppend.join, MeshDelete*, MeshVertexOffset, MeshMergeByDistance (weldArrays keeps the indexed weld for repair). DoD 7: HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData moved to ixdar.graphics.render.model; HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.compileSurface(MeshTopology) is the one compile path and the textured draw splits UVs straight from that buffer (CornerUvSplit now works on arrays); the geometry engine has no rendering code. Analysis classes take MeshTopology or packed arrays. Behaviour change: segment_cap, dual_radial_segment, bridge_edge_loops, adaptive_bridge_loops, surface_metric (and the other half-edge nodes) refuse a raw non-manifold mesh with that named message instead of passing it through.

Step 2 verification. DSL fixtures sweep (40 DSLs) byte-identical to the step-1 baseline; ring fingerprints/regions (crawfish, fertility), dungeon_2d/3d fingerprints and timing/node-inspect shapes identical (tmp/mesh60-*-diff.txt); quad suite 14/14 MATCH vs mesh-60-before, signatures and screenshots (/home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/mesh-60-after). Unit suite 538/538. Screenshots tmp/mesh-60-crawfish.png and tmp/mesh-60-subdivided-cube.png (test_function: cube subdivided twice) are bit-identical to a pristine eng-33 build (image-diff rmse 0), so no screenshot changed: loaded models keep the file's normals and the quad meshes the touched producers emit have equal-area faces, where area-weighted and unit-sum vertex normals agree. A/B re-run (HalfEdgeBuildBenchmark#representationsOnLargestModels, tmp/mesh60-bench-2.log, 7 rounds, medians, machine busier than step 1 so absolute times are higher for both): fertility build Array 3.5 / HalfEdge 2.8 ms, retained 2.2 / 6.4 MiB, compile 1.5 / 2.1 ms; buddha build 24.3 / 25.6 ms, 27.1 / 71.5 MiB, compile 5.5 / 5.0 ms; crawfish raw Array build 100.3 ms 84 MiB compile 13.2 ms (HalfEdge refused, named message); crawfish repaired build 87.3 / 74.7 ms, 84 / 237 MiB, compile 14.5 / 18.4 ms, edge lines 37.9 / 22.6 ms; repair_mesh 641 ms. First frame, interleaved base (pristine eng-33 copy) vs change, 5 rounds (tmp/mesh60-firstframe-ab.txt): crawfish, fertility and buddha all 2.0-2.1 s on both, within the 1 s resolution of the sceneReady probe, so load and first-frame are within budget. Launch entries: 'MESH-60: mesh-viewer crawfish' and 'MESH-60: mesh-viewer test_function (subdivided cube)'; a third, 'MESH-60: mesh-viewer subdivided cube', points at the group-only groups/subdivided_cube.dsl and renders nothing (wt has no remove verb; land strips it).

wt done passed (build, launch 'MESH-60: mesh-viewer crawfish', screenshot tmp/mesh-60-launch.png, marked REVIEW). eng-33 was re-committed during the work (38b096d5; NodeGraphRuntime/Scene/automation edits); wt done replayed the change onto it after one import conflict in AutomationRuntime (both sides' imports were dead). After the replay the DSL fixtures sweep and the ring/dungeon regression were re-run and are still byte-identical to the step-1 baseline.
review-summary: Every loader and node now builds a HalfEdgeMesh; ArrayMesh remains only for broken scans HalfEdgeMesh cannot hold, and ArrayMeshEngine and its converters are gone. One mesh type means one set of operators to fix and test.
